result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app screen: one truncated restaurant name and one partially visible category filter button.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated mid-word, cutting off the full name (likely 'Trattoria Piccola' or similar).
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant card names are either fully displayed or use an ellipsis (...) to indicate truncation gracefully, and consider wrapping text to a second line or resizing the card width.

issues.description: The last filter pill button in the horizontal category row (after 'Healthy') is partially cut off, showing only a sliver of the next option, which may confuse users about available categories.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual affordance such as a gradient fade or ensure at least 30-40% of the next pill is visible so users understand the row is scrollable.
